label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into doSomething which applies HTML entity escaping via Apache Commons Lang StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml. The escaped result is returned and written to the HTTP response body. Since the response writes characters (which includes the decoded entities), the malicious payload remains encoded in the output, preventing XSS execution.

evidence.note: Parameter read from request, passed to doSomething which escapes HTML, then printed to response
